title: Empty the Warrens as the fourth spell with Impact Tremors out

stack.note: cast as the fourth spell this turn

scenario.question: How many storm copies trigger, how many Goblin tokens enter in total, how much damage does Impact Tremors deal to each opponent, and if you cast Grapeshot afterward this turn, what storm count does it see?

steps.action: You cast Empty the Warrens ({3}{R}) as the fourth spell this turn; its storm ability triggers on the cast.
steps.effect: Storm triggers while Empty the Warrens is on the stack; nothing happens yet.

citations.quote: Storm is a triggered ability that functions on the stack. “Storm” means “When you cast this spell, copy it for each other spell that was cast before it this turn.
Whenever a game event or game state matches a triggered ability’s trigger event, that ability automatically triggers. The ability doesn’t do anything at this point.

steps.action: The storm trigger is put on the stack above Empty the Warrens, then resolves.
steps.effect: Three other spells were cast before Empty the Warrens this turn, so 3 copies of Empty the Warrens are put on the stack. These copies are put on the stack, NOT cast — they will not increase any later storm count.

citations.quote: Once an ability has triggered, its controller puts it on the stack as an object that’s not a card the next time a player would receive priority.
copy it for each other spell that was cast before it this turn
To copy a spell, activated ability, or triggered ability means to put a copy of it onto the stack; a copy of a spell isn’t cast

steps.action: Copy #1 resolves (copies are spells and resolve like the original).
steps.effect: Create two 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens (running total: 2 tokens). Each token entering is a creature you control entering, so Impact Tremors triggers twice.

steps.action: The two Impact Tremors triggers go on the stack and resolve one at a time.
steps.effect: Impact Tremors deals 1 damage to each opponent per trigger: 2 damage each. Opponent 1: 32 → 30. Opponent 2: 28 → 26.

steps.action: The original Empty the Warrens resolves and is put into your graveyard; its two Impact Tremors triggers resolve.
steps.effect: Two more Goblin tokens (final total: 8 tokens). Impact Tremors deals 2 more damage to each opponent. Opponent 1: 26 → 24. Opponent 2: 22 → 20. Total: 8 Impact Tremors triggers, 8 damage to each opponent.

steps.action: Later this turn you cast Grapeshot: determine its storm count.
steps.effect: Spells CAST before Grapeshot this turn: the 3 early spells + the Empty the Warrens cast = 4. The 3 storm copies of Empty the Warrens were put on the stack without being cast, so they do not count. Grapeshot is therefore the 5th spell cast this turn and its storm sees a count of 4, putting 4 copies on the stack — 5 total instances of 'Grapeshot deals 1 damage to any target' (5 damage if all aimed at one target).

final_state.summary: Empty the Warrens (4th spell cast) storm-triggers for 3 copies; 4 resolutions create 8 Goblin tokens total; Impact Tremors triggers 8 times dealing 8 damage to each opponent (32→24, 28→20). A later Grapeshot sees storm count 4 (copies were not cast) and is itself the 5th spell cast this turn.
